acceptanceCriteria: A repeatable script or make target reruns the per-test confined/unconfined comparison for declared packages and reports any outcome difference or skip increase.
Decide whether it runs periodically in CI (advisory) or before each declaration change; record the decision.
body: V1-0246 verified .corvint/test-read-scopes.json once, in a Linux container: strace proposal, confined run, then per-test go test -json outcomes compared confined vs unconfined so a test that skips on a denied read is caught. Landlock confinement in full CI only catches a too-narrow declaration whose test fails; a test that tolerates a denied read (skips, or falls back) and a declaration grown broader than needed both stay invisible. Found 2026-10-01.
title: Audit test read-scope declarations: hidden skips and stale entries
